key_stat: ALTO platform | €2.2T AUM group | Sells technology to 60+ third-party clients
summary: Amundi Technology is the technology arm of Amundi (Europe's largest asset manager, €2.2T AUM). Sells the ALTO (Amundi Leading Technologies and Operations) platform to 60+ third-party asset management firms globally. ALTO covers front-to-back investment management: portfolio management, trading, risk, compliance, data, operations. Positioned as SaaS platform for mid-tier asset managers competing with Bloomberg AIM, Charles River (State Street), SimCorp (Deutsche Börse). Strategic growth driver for Amundi group.
